results.title: What is the real name of Bhakti Vinod Thakur?
results.snippet: Bhaktivinoda Thakur (2 September 1838 – 23 June 1914), born Kedarnath Datta), was an Indian Hindu philosopher, guru and spiritual reformer of Gaudiya Vaishnavism who effected its resurgence in India in late 19th and early 20th century and was called by contemporary scholars as a Gaudiya Vaishnava leader of his time.

results.title: What is kirtan bhakti?
results.snippet: Generally speaking, kirtan, sometimes called sankirtana (literally, "collective performance"), is a kind of collective chanting or musical conversation. As a genre of religious performance art, it developed in the Indian bhakti movements as a devotional religious practice (i.e. bhakti yoga).
